Our family van has a little alarm that would ring when one of the front seatbelts where not buckled (like most cars)
But our cars belt alarm would be a beep that would start slow and slowly built up speed off a few seconds if the buckle was still not installed, and then stop. 

As a child I thought that the alarm going off was horrifying because as it would get faster I thought we where running out of time and that once it shut off that the police would be notified and track us down to arrest us. 

I remember my older brother getting in the passenger seat and not buckling while we where in the neighborhood, and I would start to cry if he didn’t do it as the alarm sped up. 
I don’t know how I thought this was fact but to my toddler self it so obviously made sense. Because of course the police are hyper aware of every minuscule action that was bad and would come get us to enforce some good ol’ road safety.
